title: NextGen Academy
description: A Django learning management system built around real usage, not just features: course enrollment, instructor tools, progress tracking, live course chat over WebSockets, a search engine backed by PostgreSQL trigram matching, and a streaming AI study assistant with full conversation history. Includes background task processing for indexing and analytics.

title: My Shop
description: A full-stack Django e-commerce platform covering the parts most tutorials skip: catalog browsing, cart logic, coupon codes, weighted shipping calculation, Stripe checkout with webhook-driven order confirmation, generated invoices, and Celery-based background tasks for order and notification processing.

title: Gold Blog
description: A Django blog platform with full authentication, publishing and draft workflows, tagging, comments, likes, RSS feeds, and email sharing — backed by PostgreSQL trigram search for fast, typo-tolerant content search, plus an integrated AI chat assistant.

title: W-Mark
description: A Django bookmarking application with email-based authentication, Google OAuth2 login, image uploads with automatic thumbnailing, and activity tracking — built to explore auth flows and media handling in depth rather than surface-level CRUD.
